Can I cancel an order after placing it, and is there a time window?

Sure thing! Orders can be canceled within 1 hour of being placed through the self-service cancellation link: Cancel order. After that, cancellation is no longer possible, but eligible items can be returned once they arrive. Let me know if you need anything else.
